report.summary: A locked-off static shot captures a refrigerated delivery truck backing into a seaside parking lot. The driver opens the rear shutter, revealing a CGI walrus inside with packed ice and fish. The walrus exits the truck bed, crawls across the asphalt, climbs over the harbor wall, and plunges into the water with a large splash, leaving the driver watching.

findings.observation: Camera remains locked-off on a static wide framing of the parking lot and harbor for the duration of the clip.
A photorealistic CGI walrus is revealed inside the refrigerated compartment on top of crushed ice.
As the walrus slides out of the truck, crushed ice and whole fish spill onto the asphalt under its weight.
The driver's eyeline tracks the walrus consistently as it moves leftward toward the harbor wall.
The walrus breaches the stone barrier wall and drops into the water, triggering an immediate large water splash effect in the harbor basin at 00:20.667.
